name: powershell-windows-cli
description: PowerShell 7 / Windows PowerShell 5.1 and CMD/Batch guidance for AI agents, focused on Windows encoding compatibility, native argument passing, quoting/escaping, legacy CP932/936/949/950, and safe shell execution.

interface.shortDescription: Encoding-safe PowerShell and native CLI execution for agents
interface.longDescription: Teach agents to use PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell 5.1, CMD/Batch, and native Windows tools while preserving text encodings and correctly handling native argv boundaries, Start-Process, cmd/batch parsing, JSON, nested shells, exit codes, and UTF-8/legacy code pages.
defaultPrompt: Use powershell-windows-cli for Windows shell tasks, especially encoding, native command arguments, quoting/escaping, cmd/batch boundaries, or nested PowerShell execution.
